primary_topics: Birthday tribute for Alberto David Lina (Bert) on his 60th birthday / passage to senior citizenship, April 23, 2008 -- requested by his daughter Donna May Lina Flavier
CJP's one-word portrait of Bert Lina: LOVE -- 'his enormous, googolplex love' -- the governing organizing principle for the entire tribute
Bert's rags-to-riches story: born poor in Tondo with roots in Laguna; met CJP in 1969 as an auditor at Baron Travel; rose to become a Filipino taipan with 18 companies in diverse fields

Fourteen manifestations of Bert's love: work, companies, employees, customers/friends, country, golf, music (Manila Symphony Orchestra), the poor, God (carillon donations), daughters, grandchildren, and Sylvia
sub_topics: Origin of the tribute: Donna May Lina (CJP's inaanak from SC100) asked CJP to speak; CJP has known Bert since 1969 when Bert was working his first job (with honors BSBA from PSBA) on the audit team of LC Diaz and Company looking at the books of Baron Travel Corporation
Rags-to-riches: 'Bert, the poor boy born in Tondo, Manila with roots in Laguna, has risen to be a giant entrepreneur, a Filipino taipan with an authentic rags-to-riches story'
The one word: 'as I tried to discover the one word that best personifies ALBERTO DAVID LINA, I came to the conclusion that that one word is LOVE, his enormous, googolplex love'
18 companies: logistics, outsourcing, communications, connectivity, films, creative designs, sports, entertainment, waste management and portalet system

2,800 employees: 'he calls them his partners and collaborators, not alalays. He loves all 2,800 of them... Each one gets a free meal everyday; and all, regardless of rank, participate in production bonuses and profit shares at the end of the year.'
Country: 'Donna tells me he talks to his daughters all the time about how to rid it of corruption and malgovernance, and about how to propel it to first world status'
Manila Symphony Orchestra: 'indefatigable sponsor of the Manila Symphony Orchestra and patron of concerts and musicales'
The poor: 'holds annual medical-surgical-dental missions for them, and literally sheds his blood during annual company blood letting'

God and carillon donations: 'donated the Carillon at the St. James Church in Alabang, as well as those in San Pedro, Laguna and in Mandaue, Cebu, because they remind him of his mortality and total dependence on God's mercies and graces every time they chime'
Four daughters: April Rose, Donna May, Lucia Jane, and Bertha Ann; 'sends them roses on Valentines and never forgets to profess aloud his love for them day and night'
Grandchildren: Andrea Rose (Andy) and Alberto Wynn (Alwyn); 'he loves to play hide and seek with them. They are the only people in the world who can countermand his orders'

Sylvia: 'loves Sylvia endearingly, tenderly and eternally. She is the light of his life and the apple and mango of his eyes. Now at 60, Bert still possesses the same business drive that he had when he was 30. But with Sylvia, he is always a swain of 20, singing ballads, writing poems and sending love letters of undying affection.' Gifted her a brand new Jaguar on her birthday; finished constructing the Sylvia P. Lina Theater

one_paragraph_summary: Delivered April 23, 2008 as a birthday tribute for Alberto David Lina (Bert) at his 60th birthday / passage to senior citizenship celebration -- invited by his daughter Donna May Lina Flavier (CJP's inaanak) -- this address by CJP opens with their 39-year relationship: CJP first met Bert in 1969 when Bert was serving his first job (with honors BSBA from PSBA) on the LC Diaz audit team examining the books of Baron Travel, CJP's family business. Bert was 'the poor boy born in Tondo, Manila with roots in Laguna' who has risen to become 'a Filipino taipan with an authentic rags-to-riches story.' CJP's governing one-word portrait: 'that one word is LOVE, his enormous, googolplex love.' The tribute enumerates thirteen love-objects: work (creates, innovates, thinks out of the box); his 18 companies (logistics, outsourcing, communications, connectivity, films, creative designs, sports, entertainment, waste management, portalet); his 2,800 employees ('partners and collaborators, not alalays'; each gets a free daily meal; all participate in production bonuses and profit shares regardless of rank); customers/friends (400 guests invited tonight); his country ('talks to his daughters all the time about how to rid it of corruption and malgovernance'); golf; music (indefatigable Manila Symphony Orchestra sponsor); the poor (annual medical-surgical-dental missions; literally sheds his blood at annual blood lettings); God (donated carillons at St. James Alabang, San Pedro Laguna, Mandaue Cebu 'because they remind him of his mortality and total dependence on God's mercies and graces every time they chime'); four daughters (April Rose, Donna May, Lucia Jane, Bertha Ann; sends roses on Valentines, professes love day and night); grandchildren Andy and Alwyn ('the only people in the world who can countermand his orders'); and Sylvia ('the light of his life and the apple and mango of his eyes... with Sylvia, he is always a swain of 20, singing ballads, writing poems and sending love letters of undying affection'; gifted her a Jaguar; built the Sylvia P. Lina Theater). Conclusion: 'ADL means A Dynamo of Love. Happy Birthday Bert!'
